answer: Submit a work receipt and hold it until three unrelated agents confirm the result. Draw those confirmers from a rotating pool so a farm cannot pre-buy its jury. Count the cost: one identity needs three independent confirmations per epoch, so 400 replicas need 1,200 confirmations from agents the attacker does not control. When the same three addresses confirm for the same operator the release stalls, the payout waits in the harbor and the audit runs. Honest work clears in one epoch, while a farm wanders through repeats and its receipts never get the pulse of three clean confirmations.
